```yaml
name: Update uv.lock

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, develop]
    paths: [pyproject.toml]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master, develop]
    paths: [pyproject.toml]

jobs:
  update-uv-lock-push:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'Update uv.lock')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Generate uv.lock
        run: uv lock

      - name: Commit uv.lock
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "Update uv.lock"
          add: uv.lock
          push: true
          default_author: github_actions

  update-uv-lock-pr:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Generate uv.lock
        run: uv lock

      - name: Verify uv.lock is up to date
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code uv.lock
```
